records.name: Azir Rammus (Sprykin Azir & Rammus)

level_plan.action: econ to level 7; roll a little at 6 only with key pairs
have 2* Azir and Rammus, then slow roll above 50 gold for 3 stars

tips: Needs many Needlessly Large Rods: take item augments early, take rods from carousel.
Blackthorn sacrifice hex scales with gold value: 3* Teemo > 2* AP 4-cost without items > 2* Teemo > 2* Veigar.
Blackthorn Lux is a strong win condition.
Stage 2: angle with early Azir, ideally a Blossom opener for better Wisps.
records.note: Guide screenshot (tier S). 7 units at level 7. Carry items not read: the icons are too small.

records.name: Kha'Zix reroll (Elderwood Kha'Zix & Hecarim)

level_plan.action: slam items aggressively on Kha'Zix, move them later
econ to level 7; roll a little at 6 only with key pairs
slow roll at 7 for the 3-cost 3 stars

tips: With Hand of Justice first go Executioner > Ravager; with AP / Mana / tempo items go Ravager > Executioner; then Spellweaver > Rapidfire with the last evolutions.
3rd Executioner / Lux / Ivern as the level cap.
Give leftover AP items to Diana.
Elderwood plants (Lifebloom, Stonebark Tree) on the board.
records.note: Guide screenshot (tier S, Turkish page title 'Ay Ağacı Kha'Zix'). Carry items not read: the icons are too small.

records.name: Riftbeast Reroll (Pebbles & Krug)

level_plan.action: slam items, win streak with Pebbles items; Alpha Mark on Scuttlecrab or Gromp
save econ and go 7 for 7 Riftbeast (4-1 if poor); use the 5-Riftbeast shops to finish 3 stars
after the 3 stars, level to 8 and field 7 Riftbeast; at 9 replace 1* Ravagers with Elder Dragon

tips: Every Riftbeast carry except Mama Beak can carry with items.
Krug 3* is the best tank; else Sentinel 2* > Scuttlecrab 3*.
Alpha Mark: Cinderling early, Scuttlecrab late.
records.note: Guide screenshot (tier A, 1-cost reroll, easy). Carry items not read: the icons are too small.

records.name: Draven Ezreal 9

level_plan.action: slam items, full win streak with Draven items; resource-engine opener (Rengar, Blossom)
keep win streaking; with an econ augment go fast 7 before 3-3
fast 9 for the scaling 5-costs (Draven, Maokai, Ivern)

tips: Only from an early win streak and lots of gold.
Best Draven quests: damage for gold; avoid the 10k damage in one round (can get trapped).
